result.rationale: Retain as U.S. development-stage airport infrastructure. Tiger remains controlling Fund III sponsor; Alaska Future Fund was disclosed as co-owner. The airport is lessor; the project is delayed and not operating.

identityResolution.projectLeaseEntity: NorthLink Aviation LLC (formerly IC Alaska Airport LLC); no separate lease SPV found.
identityResolution.originalSponsor: Investment Company of Alaska LLC (C Change Group; Russell Read and John Tichotsky)
identityResolution.landlord: State of Alaska DOT&PF / Ted Stevens Anchorage International Airport
identityResolution.boundary: One company; all campus facilities/phases stay beneath it.
identityResolution.leaseEquity: ADA-32351 is a lease/concession, not landlord equity.

ownershipResolution.control: Tiger is the disclosed controlling investor.

operatingResolution.lease: ADA-32351; State/ANC lessor; 55 years/120 acres; executed 2021-11-03.
operatingResolution.buildout: 80-acre apron; 15 stands (11 power-through/4 push-back); 90,000-sf warehouse with office, hydrant fuel, glycol recovery and ground-service support.
operatingResolution.progress: FAA approval/groundbreaking came in 2023; 2024 work was limited and main construction had not begun by mid-2025. Latest AIAS reporting shows phased construction and six stands planned by 2027.
operatingResolution.customers: Cathay was reported as anchor/capacity customer; no evidence shows terminal use began.
operatingResolution.developmentPartners: MCG Explore Design; Cornerstone General Contractors

acquisitionExitCheck.acquisition: CLOSED 2021-11-03; lease executed simultaneously; no separate close date disclosed.
acquisitionExitCheck.laterSearch: No public financing, raise, transfer, sale, Tiger exit or pending deal found by cutoff.
